changeSet.author: nfnn
changeSet.sql: update donor_sender_account set id = gen_random_uuid(), created_at = learned_at
alter table donor_sender_account add constraint ck_donor_sender_account_status check (status in ('ACTIVE', 'AWAITING_PAYMENT', 'DISCONNECTED'))

alter table donor_sender_account add constraint ck_donor_sender_account_proof check ((learned_from_payment_id is null) = (learned_at is null) and (status <> 'ACTIVE' or learned_from_payment_id is not null))

alter table donor_sender_account add constraint ck_donor_sender_account_disconnected check ((status = 'DISCONNECTED') = (valid_to is not null) and (status = 'DISCONNECTED') = (disconnected_at is not null))
alter table donor_sender_account add constraint ck_donor_sender_account_period check (valid_from is null or valid_to is null or valid_to >= valid_from)
create unique index uq_donor_sender_account_live on donor_sender_account (donor_id, account_number, bank_code) where status <> 'DISCONNECTED'

update donation d set sender_account_id = a.id from bank_payment p, donor_sender_account a where d.paired_by = 'SENDER_ACCOUNT' and d.bank_payment_id = p.id and a.donor_id = d.donor_id and a.account_number = p.sender_account_number and a.bank_code = p.sender_bank_code
alter table donation add constraint ck_donation_sender_account_only_for_account_pairing check (sender_account_id is null or paired_by = 'SENDER_ACCOUNT')
